name: io.github.marc-aurele-besner/mymultisig-mcp
title: MyMultiSig
description: Create, review, sign and execute MyMultiSig multisig wallet transactions from AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: MYMULTISIG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Scoped API key (mms_…) from https://mymultisig.app/settings/agents; acts as your wallet on the API

environmentVariables.name: MYMULTISIG_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's own owner key (0x + 64 hex). Enables signing, executing and deploying; used locally only

environmentVariables.name: MYMULTISIG_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register read-only tools
